name: SINKUNG
recent: Sin-Kung Logistics 近期签署了多项谅解备忘录，并发布了截至2026年9月30日的季度业绩。新闻指出第三季度营收同比增长85.5%，但年初至今亏损扩大至788万令吉。此外，公司董事局出现变动。
notable: 公司签署了多项谅解备忘录（MOU）。
公司发布了截至2026年9月30日的季度财报。
公司董事局出现变动，Angeline Ong Lay Shee 离任。
risks: 年初至今亏损扩大至788万令吉。
公司签署了多项谅解备忘录，但具体内容未在标题中披露。
earnings: 截至2026年6月30日季度，营收为2452.6万令吉，环比增长48.1%，同比增长51.9%；净亏损为387.6万令吉，净亏损率为15.8%，较上一季度的26.6%有所收窄。

recent_en: Sin-Kung Logistics recently entered into several memoranda of understanding and announced its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026. News reported Q3 revenue up 85.5% year-on-year, but year-to-date loss widened to RM7.88 million. There was also a change in the boardroom.
notable_en: The company entered into several memoranda of understanding (MOUs).
The company announced its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026.
There was a change in the boardroom with the departure of Angeline Ong Lay Shee.
risks_en: Year-to-date loss widened to RM7.88 million.
The company signed several MOUs, but details were not disclosed in the titles.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM24.526 million, up 48.1% QoQ and 51.9% YoY; net loss was RM3.876 million with a net margin of -15.8%, narrowing from -26.6% in the previous quarter.
